integrity: Proof uses exact polynomial identities, closed-simplex nonnegativity, and the source finite-minimum theorem; rational-grid tests are supplementary. No external independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result refutes the k=4 conjectured extremality but does not classify globally optimal cubic minorants or address other support sizes; coefficient 2 is sharp only within Q4+alpha*p1*p2*p4. Equivalence to prior unindexed works cannot be absolutely excluded.
title: A sharp cubic improvement to the four-point renewal minimum
